angles.text: Where a jev typed decision replaces free prose inside the agi loop: rank the sites (verdict choice with :N, accept/demote at review, rebrief N/C, big-vs-small, node/session naming, next-tool-call suggestion, spawn-gate judgments) by knowledge-per-token; each hypothesis names the write.py verb / rotate step / dispatch or review seam it plugs into, the replay corpus on this box (1,943 kid output.logs, 1,295 experiment nodes, 171 verdicts), the metric (top-1 agreement, USD/decision, latency) and the bar. WALL: 600 s hard limit -- read the three digests + critiques from the scratch dir first (they are on disk), write at most 3 chains x 3 hypotheses, emit by minute 8.

The owner's design: a three-layer jev-MCP sandwich (jev in front of MCP reading intent and suggesting MCP actions; MCP; jev after MCP reading the pre-MCP jev inputs and dispatching tool-call suggestions to be confirmed or modified, eventually auto-dispatched with a 10-60 s undo delay) and a live transcript view with call suggestions. Chains must start with a $0-cost replay measurement before any UI, state the agreement bar that earns a UI, and the failure mode where a suggestion layer ADDS a confirm step to every call instead of removing calls. WALL: 600 s hard limit -- read the three digests + critiques from the scratch dir first (they are on disk), write at most 3 chains x 3 hypotheses, emit by minute 8.

The agi graph already types acts the way jev types outputs (node schemas with required fields, spawn gates on parent shapes, a six-word verdict vocabulary with :N, write.py verbs, branch and rotation grammars). Chains here test where the two coincide: a jev-backed gate inside write.py/spawn_gate, typed verdicts scored by jev against the evidence, schema fields filled by typed decisions, and what the graph would lose (auditability, determinism, $0 cost) at each site -- every hypothesis must name the cost in USD per 1k acts and the determinism/audit consequence. WALL: 600 s hard limit -- read the three digests + critiques from the scratch dir first (they are on disk), write at most 3 chains x 3 hypotheses, emit by minute 8.
